in_sanskrit.name: Kalai
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Time, Progress
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kalai एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'kala', meaning 'time', 'progress', or 'cycle'. In Hindu mythology, Kalai is the goddess of time, creativity, and art.

in_tamil.name: கலை
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil word 'கலை' translates to 'time' or 'age'. It is derived from the root word 'கல்' (kal), which means 'to cut'. The concept of time is derived from the idea of the continuous flow of life, which is likened to a river that cannot be stopped or measured without cutting it at certain intervals.
